{{Quote|Death Watch is far stronger than we once thought. But we have been training for this. We can stop them. But if we are to combat them effectively, we must have the temerity to stand strong in the name of peace. And if we are to do so, we must reject any Republic assistance. Instead, this government will act. It acts not out of pride, but for safety. Intervention by the Republic will inflame the opposition and this is why our government rejects the help of the Jedi. We must listen to the Duchess Satine. If we do not, we will ultimately cause our defeat.|Jerec, attesting to the strength of the New Mandalorian government|<ref name="DoM" />}}
'''Jerec''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], and a member of the peaceful [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction for which he served as a [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]] in their government. A friend of the New Mandalorian's leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], Jerec supported her methods for dealing with the resurgent Mandalorian radicals known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. It would be the Death Watch who was responsible for Jerec's [[Death/Legends|death]], when he fell victim to a [[Bombing on Kalevala/Legends|bombing]] perpetrated by the Death Watch while on [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]]. A [[Hologram/Legends|holorecording]] of a speech that he made supporting Duchess Kryze was altered by an individual within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] government, and the faked testimonial was shown to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] with the intent of manipulating the Senate to vote on sending Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to occupy [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The true recording, in which Jerec reveals that Republic assistance would only throw public support to Death Watch, was eventually uncovered by an [[Davu Golec/Legends|agent]] of the Republic's [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]] and broadcast before the Senate. Upon seeing the truth, the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] rescinded their votes in favor of Republic occupation of Mandalore, allowing the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to remain neutral in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|Something here isn't right. I wish to speak to Jerec immediately!''"<br />"''Sadly, Deputy Minister Jerec perished this morning, in a Death Watch bombing on Kalevala. Let us ensure that his death was ''not'' in vain.|[[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="DoM" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], Jerec was a member of the pacifist Mandalorian faction who called themselves the "[[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]." During the course of his life, Jerec became close friends with the New Mandalorians' leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]<ref name="DoM" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]].<ref name="Voyage of Temptation">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref> While the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the New Mandalorians were presented a problem of their own: the return of the radical Mandalorian splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]],<ref name="TMP">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> fractured and thought destroyed [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior by [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons">''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''</ref><ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> When the Republic found the Death Watch forces to be a significant threat, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] began to draft a [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|resolution]] to safeguard [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] standings with the Republic by sending a contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world.<ref name="DoM" />

[[File:Mandalore_Defense_Initiative.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Jerec's holorecord testimonial is presented to the Senate]]
While Jerec's good friend, Duchess Kryze, traveled from Mandalore to the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to argue in opposition to the proposed occupation, Jerec journeyed to Kalevala,<ref name="DoM" /> a nearby New Mandalorian stronghold world also in the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It was on Kalevala that Jerec was [[Death/Legends|killed]]—falling victim to a [[Bombing on Kalevala/Legends|bombing]] orchestrated by the Death Watch—but not before he could transmit a [[Hologram/Legends|recorded]] testimony to the Republic Senate in which he continued to support Kryze and her position against Republic intervention in the Mandalorian affair. However, the recording was intercepted and altered by another party, who then delivered the doctored testimony to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Chamber]] for presentation to the assembled [[Senator/Legends|senators]]. His words twisted, Jerec appeared to turn on his long time friend and pleaded with the Senate for Republic aid, and the Senate passed the defense resolution for Mandalore. The truth would come to light thanks to Republic [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]] employee [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]], who acquired the original recording and passed it along to Duchess Kryze. When Jerec's true testimonial was played before the Senate, the government body's opinion was swayed and the occupation of the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was voted down, allowing Mandalore to retain the neutrality Jerec and Kryze had sought.<ref name="DoM" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Deputy Minister Jerec is an honorable man! He would never commit such lies to the record.|Satine Kryze|<ref name="DoM" />}}
Jerec was a close friend of the New Mandalorian leader, Duchess Satine Kryze, and a supporter of her goals for a neutral Mandalore. As the threat of the Death Watch returned, their [[Attack on the Memorial Shrine/Legends|violence]] turned against the peaceful New Mandalorian society, Jerec spoke out against the Republic getting involved, knowing that any intervention by Republic forces could cast the Death Watch in a more favorable light. He instead put his faith in Kryze's own methods, and urged the Republic to do the same. Considered an honorable man by those who knew him,<ref name="DoM" /> Jerec was thought to exemplify the Mandalorian tradition of leaders being forthcoming with the greater Mandalorian people.<ref name="DoM" /><ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>
